Subject: Request: POC extension + additional credits

Hi Laura / Karthik,

Thanks again for the quick demo yesterday — the team was impressed. We are walking this through procurement and a couple of internal stakeholders have asked for more runway to validate the model under heavier loads. Our current PLG trial caps and the standard 14-day POC window won't cover the production-like volume we need to stress.

Can Redwood approve: 1) a 30-day extension to the POC window and 2) an additional 50k free token credits to run the hit-rate / latency benchmarks we discussed? We view this as a blocker to procurement sign-off; our procurement lead (Rajiv) is copied.

We are targeting a Q2 pilot rollout and the ARR upside is likely >$200k if the benchmarks hold. Happy to provide a short mutual action plan if that helps.

Appreciate any flexibility here — Hannah

--
Hannah Lee
Director of Platform Engineering | FinTech Pros

Laura / Rishi — forwarding the ask from FinTech Pros. Quick summary: they want 30 days + 50k free tokens. Potential ARR >$200k, procurement engaged. They said benchmarks will drive sign-off.

My stance: Approve a partial exception — likely 30k credits + 2-week extension by default. For the remainder (or full 50k) we need exec approval (credit waiver + non-standard PLG terms). Also flagged for legal/finance if we need an amendment.

Two asks for quick decision: 1) Rishi: can you sign off on up to 30k credits + 2-week extension under standard terms? 2) Laura: if we push to 50k and 30 days, we should ask for a short mutual action plan and an SLA commitment window in HubSpot — can you review and escalate if needed?

- Require the customer to sign the simple amendment (Amendment_SOW_draft.docx) that documents the credit and extension and includes a milestone-based credit clawback if they cancel before a pilot purchase.

Rishi
